classes.name: TopExp
classes.summary:
This package provides basic tools to explore the topological data structures.
- Explorer: A tool to find all sub-shapes of a given type. e.g. all faces of a solid.
- Package methods to map sub-shapes of a shape.
Level : Public All methods of all classes will be public.

staticMethods.name: MapShapes
MapShapes
staticMethods.signature: (S: TopoDS_Shape, M: NCollection_IndexedMap_TopoDS_Shape_TopTools_ShapeMapHasher, cumOri: boolean, cumLoc: boolean): void
staticMethods.comment:
Stores in the map <M> all the sub-shapes of .
- If cumOri is true, the function composes all sub-shapes with the orientation of S.
- If cumLoc is true, the function multiplies all sub-shapes by the location of S, i.e. it applies to each sub-shape the transformation that is associated with S.
@param M Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

staticMethods.name: MapShapesAndAncestors
staticMethods.signature: (S: TopoDS_Shape, TS: TopAbs_ShapeEnum, TA: TopAbs_ShapeEnum, M: NCollection_IndexedDataMap_TopoDS_Shape_NCollection_List_TopoDS_Shape_TopTools_ShapeMapHasher): void
staticMethods.comment:
Stores in the map <M> all the subshape of of type <TS> for each one append to the list all the ancestors of type <TA>. For example map all the edges and bind the list of faces. Warning: The map is not cleared at first.
@param M Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

staticMethods.name: MapShapesAndUniqueAncestors
staticMethods.signature: (S: TopoDS_Shape, TS: TopAbs_ShapeEnum, TA: TopAbs_ShapeEnum, M: NCollection_IndexedDataMap_TopoDS_Shape_NCollection_List_TopoDS_Shape_TopTools_ShapeMapHasher, useOrientation: boolean): void
staticMethods.comment:
Stores in the map <M> all the subshape of of type <TS> for each one append to the list all unique ancestors of type <TA>. For example map all the edges and bind the list of faces. useOrientation = True : taking account the ancestor orientation Warning: The map is not cleared at first.
@param M Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

classes.name: TopExp_Explorer

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates an empty explorer, becomes useful after Init.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment:
Creates an Explorer on the Shape .
<ToFind> is the type of shapes to search. TopAbs_VERTEX, TopAbs_EDGE, ...
<ToAvoid> is the type of shape to skip in the exploration. If <ToAvoid> is equal or less complex than <ToFind> or if <ToAVoid> is SHAPE it has no effect on the exploration.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.signature: (S: TopoDS_Shape, ToFind: TopAbs_ShapeEnum, ToAvoid?: TopAbs_ShapeEnum): void
instanceMethods.comment: Resets this explorer on the shape S. It is initialized to search the shape S, for shapes of type ToFind, that are not part of a shape ToAvoid. If the shape ToAvoid is equal to TopAbs_SHAPE, or if it is the same as, or less complex than, the shape ToFind it has no effect on the search.

instanceMethods.name: More
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if there are more shapes in the exploration.

instanceMethods.name: Next
instanceMethods.comment: Moves to the next Shape in the exploration.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the current shape in the exploration.

instanceMethods.name: Current
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the current shape in the exploration.

instanceMethods.name: ReInit
instanceMethods.comment: Reinitialize the exploration with the original arguments.

instanceMethods.name: Depth
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the current depth of the exploration. 0 is the shape to explore itself.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Clears the content of the explorer.

instanceMethods.name: end
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a sentinel marking the end of iteration.
